public_statement: For the finite or explicitly enumerated countable index set $I$ of [[def-tdmath-diagonal-operator-model]], the inner-product space $\ell^2(I)$ is complete and therefore a complex Hilbert space, with inner product linear in the first variable. For any real family $(E_i)$, the displayed domain $D(H_E)$ is a linear subspace containing every finite-support vector, is dense in $\ell^2(I)$, and $x\mapsto(E_ix_i)_i$ is a linear map from that domain into $\ell^2(I)$. These assertions also hold for the empty finite index set.
